shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('next/package.json').version"
cat next.config.ts lib/projects.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Core' -H 'x-region: eu-west' localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '(Welcome|Team|Region|[0-9]+ active)[^<]*(<!-- -->[^<]*)?' ; echo ---; curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '(Welcome|Team|Region)[^<]*(<!-- -->[^<]*)?'; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
ls .next/server/app/ | grep -i index; grep -o '<main>.*</main>' .next/server/app/index.html | head -c 800; echo; git status --short
